data: Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.

ESA’s star-charting satellite, mapping the position, brightness, and motion of nearly two billion stars in the Milky Way at unprecedented precision. Operated 2013–2025; the resulting catalogue will underpin galactic astronomy for decades.
Dark-energy survey across one third of the sky
Spun apart in orbit; loss drove XRISM development

ESA's stellar cartographer at L2. Mapping 1.8 billion stars — measuring positions to 7 microarcseconds. Has measured distances to stars 30,000 light-years away with the precision of a human hair's width at 1,000 km distance. The most detailed map of the Milky Way ever made.
